thread:
maya: Hey team — pushing a draft of the customer-facing audit event pack + changelog. Wanted quick eyeballs on: (1) sample payload clarity, (2) compatibility notes for customers using KMS + RBAC, and (3) wording for the public changelog entry. pinging @alex @sam @beth for review :wave:

alex: Looks good at a glance. Couple Qs: do we call out timeline for the schema version bump anywhere? customers will ask when SDKs will validate.

sam: Important: customers with KMS-integrated keys need to know we added a new 'key_id' field to KeyRotation events and we will omit secret material. Also we introduced an 'audit.read' scope — will that be required to fetch audit exports?

maya: Short answers: yes on 'audit.read' for the exports endpoint, documented. Not required for local log downloads. Schema bump: v3.1 -> v4.0 (breaking: renamed 'actor'->'initiator' and added 'key_id' optional).

beth: For docs: I suggest a short migration snippet and a compatibility table. Also add a customer-facing migration checklist: test parsing, update validators, run sample exports.

ryan: I'm adding a backfill job to tag old events with 'initiator' where possible. Will post PR. ETA EOD tomorrow.

alex: Can we include a JSON sample customers can paste into their validators? That helps reduce support load. Example snippet below?

alex: ```json
{
  "schema_version": "4.0",
  "event_type": "KeyRotation",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T15:23:12Z",
  "initiator": { "id": "user_123", "type": "user" },
  "key_id": "projects/prod/keys/abc-123",
  "details": { "rotated_from": "2025-12-12T00:00:00Z" }
}
```

sam: Good. Add note: we never include key material or plaintext secrets in any event. Also mention that PII fields are redacted (see redaction policy link).

beth: Changelog draft line: "audit-events: schema v4.0 — actor renamed to initiator, key_id added to KMS events, API adds audit.read scope; see migration guide." Keep it short.

maya: +1. For customer comms: short email + doc link. Include an example curl to fetch exports requiring audit.read:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports?since=2026-03-01
```

ryan: deploy-bot created PR #8123 for backfill and #8130 for docs. deploy-bot: PRs can be reviewed at https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pulls?q=8130 OR 8123

deploy-bot: PR #8123 opened by ryan: backfill/add-initiator-tag, CI passing. 

maya: Thanks. Action items: alex — add validator sample + unit test; beth — final docs + migration checklist; sam — add KMS compatibility note and redaction language; ryan — run backfill and share runbook; I'll draft the public changelog entry and the customer email. I'll post the draft email here in an hour for review. :memo:

alex: I'll drop unit tests and a small docs snippet in the PR this afternoon.

sam: Also filing a short SA (security advisory) note internally just in case customers misinterpret key_id. Will keep it internal.

beth: If anyone wants to add customer-facing examples, include a parsing example in Python using the SDK so they can validate events locally.

maya: Great. Closing loop for now — will follow up with the email and release notes. If anything urgent, flag here. :thumbsup:
